published_baseline: Founder-approved published website baseline after the #1414 Intelligence score-truth presentation fix and the #1128 permanent mobile information-hierarchy hardening. /intelligence defaults to Newest so newer verified evidence is not hidden behind an older higher-severity record; Highest risk remains explicitly selectable. Risk-domain summaries show each domain's latest verified score and original evidence date rather than an average that can obscure recency. Current scored rows are labelled Verified current score; quiet or historical scored rows remain Last verified score. Feed refresh time is shown separately from score evidence time, so a continuously checked domain is never falsely presented as having a newly changed score. No score, timestamp, source eligibility or freshness is synthesized. Live observations remain separately labelled and unscored until canonical classification. Raw publisher content/provider details remain hidden. The #1128 mobile presentation keeps the same product/data logic while applying mobile-first Bridge/Swap gutters, vertical rhythm, stacked wallet/actions and safe wrapping for long wallet/transaction identifiers. /global-risk remains independently hard-pinned by config/global-risk-final-lock.json and its dedicated fail-closed verifier.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update. The finalized /global-risk presentation is additionally protected by its independent permanent lock.
